changes.text: EgoForce: data released on Hugging Face (zhicao/EgoForce, 1.9 TB, CC BY-NC 4.0, ungated); availability announced -> public. The card counts 739 h, 18,373 recordings, 25 tasks and 191 collectors with 5 x 12 fingertip taxels per hand in newtons (palm taxels not included), against the paper's 2,000 h and 40k episodes. The project page still shows 'Code (Coming Soon)'.
FACT: the project page 'Data' button now links the EgoForce release; code stays 'Coming Soon' and no weights were found, so release status is unchanged (code announced, weights not released).

TactiDex: a 'Dataset' button on the project page now opens a Google Drive folder listing TactiDex_Output.zip (45.02 GB) and TactiDex_objects.zip (138.3 MB) without sign-in; availability not_released -> public. Folder contents, license and layout were not opened.
TactiSkill: the project page lost its 'Coming Soon' wording and now shows only Paper, arXiv, Video and Dataset links; no code repository or weights link exists, so code stays announced.

TouchBridge: code released on GitHub (touchbridge2026/TouchBridge, created 2026-11-17: pipeline for masks, inpainting, tactile-conditioned retargeting and Zarr export, glove parts, MOZ and dual Wuji robot model); code announced -> released. License not stated and no TouchBridge weights or task data in the repository.

DexTacWAM: the six task sets (595 trajectories, 314,281 frames by the card) were also posted on 2026-11-22 as zarr files in JensenYuan/DexTacWAM_OXT (ungated, 381 GB, card license CC-BY-4.0) for Open-X-Tactile. Bottle cap, cube place, handover and whiteboard counts match the LeRobot sets; tongs shows 92,241 frames against 55,691 and bowl 36,669 against 36,712. Availability stays public.

RSS Dual-Arm Tactile: a second task, dual-arm USB plugging, appeared from 2026-11-08 (57 + 43 successful trajectories and 8 failures), and rollout folders added since 2026-11-03 (120 pour episodes of 2026-11-02/03, 140 USB-plug episodes of 2026-11-15 to 11-20, 40 pour evaluation trials of 2026-11-21/22). Episodes 100 -> 200, tasks 1 -> 2. The card gives 516 GB against 238.4 GB from the API; availability stays gated (manual approval) and no gated file was opened.

TacWAM Wet-Lab Tasks: the repository grew from 23,188 to 23,225 files (176.7 GB by the API) and now lists task_case_study_20261104, task_media_20261023 and dual_arm_third_person_pov_20261019; gate still manual and no gated file was opened, so counts are unchanged.

DextraVerse: the Hugging Face repository was renamed to ntumars/DextraVerse_OXT on 2026-11-23 and its archive folder to DextraVerse_OXT/; the card says the old address redirects and the archives are byte-identical. Link updated, availability stays public (CC BY 4.0).

TactileLab In-Hand Rotation: the repository is now Kitval/TactileLab_InHandRotation_OXT and its card links the paper TactileLab (arXiv 2611.07881, 2026-11-05). Still ungated, 20 episodes, 1.9 GB, no license stated; paper and link added.

EgoExplorer: the code repository moved from InternRobotics/EgoExplorer to Sage-PhysicalAI/EgoExplorer (last push 2026-10-23); the Hugging Face dataset is unchanged under InternRobotics (gate manual, last modified 2026-10-22). Code link updated.
